claims.statement: Let A/Qbar have dimension d and good reduction A0/Fpbar at the fixed place w. For 0 <= r <= d and rational Hodge gamma in H^(2r)(A(C),Q(r)), every list of Cartier divisors D1,...,D_(d-r) on A0 has a q in Q for which the cycle-normalized traces of gamma_(0,v) times their Chern classes equal q for all ell != p and in crystalline cohomology extended to Cw. The divisor product is 1 for r=d. The assertion is for every prime, including 2, at the fixed place; q depends on the prescribed data.
actual_source_dependencies: The recorded four-claim spine is assembled through cor:cm-pairing.
Codimension zero/top and dimension zero use normalized divisor/point traces.
The companion CM Hodge assertion is explicitly not an input.
claims.known_result_reproduction: Not classified as a known-result reproduction or a developed Argus result; original-claim novelty is not assessed.

claims.remaining_obligation: Independently verify the CM transport, balanced CM reduction, balanced-Weil dichotomy and common-realization rational pullback assembly. The local PF realization certificate alone does not establish that spine.

claims.statement: For positive-dimensional good-reduction A/Qbar and a rational Hodge gamma of codimension 0 <= r <= dim A, there are n>0, a good-reduction CM B/Qbar, a rational Hodge kappa of codimension r on B and one special-fiber quasi-isogeny a:A0^n -> B0 such that gamma0=(a j)^* kappa0 simultaneously in all prime-to-p and extended crystalline realizations, with j the first-factor inclusion.
actual_source_dependencies: prop:transport(1), the Mumford-Tate Hodge embedding, and trace-tensor construction/comparison.
Kisin-Zhou Theorem 2.2.7 supplies a tensor-preserving quasi-isogeny to a special-point lift.
Canonical-model algebraicity of special points gives the CM lift over Qbar.
This branch does not depend on MR-PRESCRIBED-TRANSPORT or PF-REALIZATION.
claims.known_result_reproduction: Uses an explicitly cited special-point lifting theorem; no independent Argus reproduction of the resulting transport corollary.
claims.Argus_evidence_status: Source context only for this branch; local prescribed-period realization does not certify it.
claims.remaining_obligation: Check the special-point theorem's application to the constructed integral-model point and the exact simultaneous normalized Hodge-class equality under one algebraic quasi-isogeny. No same-dimensional CM lift or generic-fiber map is supplied by the statement.

claims.statement: Let positive-dimensional good-reduction A/Qbar have V=H1(A(C),Q), connected reductive Hodge embedding G in GSp(V,psi), and rational Hodge gamma represented by an alternating form of multiplier c^r. If the degree-0,1 filtration F_A on D_A=Hcris^1(A0)[1/p], over a finite extension of K0, is weakly admissible, has finite local-field descent with the specialized G-structure tensors, and lies geometrically in the original G-orbit under a tensor-preserving identification, then some n>0 and auxiliary good-reduction B over finite K/K0 admit a quasi-isogeny a:A0^n -> B0 and rational Hodge kappa with (a j)^*kappa0=gamma0 simultaneously and a^*Fil^1 H_dR^1(B/K)=(F_A^1)^direct_sum_n after a common finite extension. Hodge classes on B use the indicated complex embedding; realizations use canonical tensors and polarization.
actual_source_dependencies: All four recorded dependencies, with the finite-descent hypothesis retained for weak-admissible-implies-admissible.
The starting point/isogeny and trace tensor, complete tensor descent, and diagonal G-to-J orbit compatibility are source preparation.
Canonical tensor and polarization comparisons are needed for the local lift's normalized class.

claims.remaining_obligation: The existing local Argus proof does not itself construct the auxiliary datum, starting global point and trace tensor, prove full-family descent, or give the common rational normalization. Those conditional source preparations remain distinct from marked realization.

claims.statement: For a Hodge embedding (G,X) -> (GSp(V,psi),X_Siegel), G connected with similitude c, and any prime p, there exist totally real P, connected reductive J and a Hodge embedding on W. The maps G -> J -> Res_(P/Q)G_P have G diagonal and J the equal-multiplier subgroup; J_Qp is quasi-split with full connected stabilizer Jcal giving a strongly admissible datum; W is (V tensor_Q P)^direct_sum_m for m>0 with common multiplier c; Jcal embeds closed into GL of a self-dual Zp lattice. Strong admissibility includes the relevant R-smooth centralizer and reduced relative roots at p=2.
actual_source_dependencies: Splitting-field approximation and the equal-multiplier fiber-product construction.
Kisin-Zhou earlier Lemma 4.2.4 and Proposition 2.4.6.
Kisin-Zhou 2025 Definition 2.1.6, Proposition 2.1.9 and explicit local strong-admissibility checks.
claims.known_result_reproduction: Source application of cited construction tools; not independently reproduced by Argus, and no novelty assessment.
claims.Argus_evidence_status: The local Argus realization statement assumes a fixed datum of this form.
claims.remaining_obligation: Construct the isotypic restriction-of-scalars representation and check connected full stabilizer, strong admissibility and closed self-dual integral embedding at every prime, including 2. The matrix and tensor-propagation certificates do not do this.

claims.statement: In the constructed transport setting, let f0:A0^n -> Cx, a=b f0:A0^n -> B0, theta_star=f0^*theta_(C,0) rational ample and D=n dim A>0. If the same a preserves the untwisted tensors u_psi=psi_W tensor psi_W^(-1) and u_eta=eta tensor (psi_W^(-1))^tensor_r, its local polarization scalars a^*theta_(B,0)=lambda_v theta_star all equal lambda=deg(a^*theta_(B,0) theta_star^(D-1))/deg(theta_star^D) in Q^nonzero. Thus a^*eta_(B,0)=lambda^r f0^*eta_(C,0) simultaneously, and kappa=lambda^(-r) eta_B/[P:Q] gives the first-factor class equality.
actual_source_dependencies: One algebraic quasi-isogeny preserving both untwisted tensors in every realization.
Actual rational divisor classes on the same special fiber, ampleness of theta_star and cycle-normalized traces.
The preceding trace restriction contributes the factor [P:Q].

claims.statement: Let A0/Fpbar carry rational CM-field action E and polarization with Rosati conjugation on E. Let D=Hcris^1(A0)[1/p] have E tensor K0 rank 2s, s>=1, and invertible u in End^0(A0) satisfy u^dagger=u and u e=bar(e)u. For the dual slope-one polarization beta there exist finite K/K0 and L subset D_K whose one-step filtration is weakly admissible, E- and u-stable, beta-Lagrangian, and of dimension s at each geometric embedding of E. The isocrystal, indicated tensors and filtration have finite local-field descent. Geometrically L belongs to the single balanced polarized cocharacter orbit of G_D={g in GSp(D,beta) intersect GL_(E tensor K0)(D): det_(E tensor K0)(g)=c(g)^s}, with weights 0 and 1.
actual_source_dependencies: Internal bounded-degree avoidance and Lagrangian-intersection lemmas.
Maximum-defect reduction to E,u-stable subobjects and slope-graded intersection bounds, even if Frobenius permutes embedding blocks.
Finite local-field descent is part of the existence assertion.
Colmez-Fontaine admissibility is a subsequent corollary, not this existence theorem itself.

claims.Argus_evidence_status: Local realization takes an admissible filtration as input; no Argus evidence constructs this constrained filtration.
claims.remaining_obligation: Construct the E,u-stable balanced Lagrangian with equality of total Hodge/Newton numbers and inequalities against every subisocrystal, and establish its stated descent. Checking the geometric flag orbit or admissibility of already-given data does not establish this existence theorem.

claims.statement: Let good-reduction A/Qbar have CM-field action E, compatible Rosati polarization, E-rank 2s homology with s>=1, and Hodge multiplicities (s,s) at every embedding. Its rational Weil space W_E^s(A) in H^(2s)(A,Q(s)) has geometric support the sum over tau of wedge^(2s) V_tau^dual. For U={u in End^0(A0):u^dagger=u and u e=bar(e)u for all e in E}, every gamma in W_E^s(A) has the Lefschetz pairing property. If U has no invertible element all complementary pairings vanish; if it has an invertible element gamma0 is a simultaneous rational Lefschetz class.
actual_source_dependencies: The recorded six claims form the principal spine.

claims.statement: For a good-reduction balanced Weil abelian variety with CM field E, E-rank 2s homology, compatible Rosati polarization and (s,s) Hodge multiplicities, suppose U={u in End^0(A0):u^dagger=u, u e=bar(e)u} has no invertible element. Then every specialized class in W_E^s(A) is orthogonal to every complementary Lefschetz class, separately in all prime-to-p and extended crystalline realizations.
actual_source_dependencies: Hard Lefschetz on the divisor algebra, cited to Milne 1999.
Rosati block projection, polynomial openness and rational density.
An E-stable nonzero algebraic kernel has positive multiplicity at every embedding, using a common rational characteristic polynomial and rational Poincare reducibility.

claims.statement: For the balanced polarized E-representation V of E-rank 2s, G={a in GSp(V,psi) intersect GL_E(V):det_E(a)=c(a)^s}, with diagonal scalar on the right, is connected reductive. The Hodge homomorphism factors through G and gives a Hodge-type Shimura datum in that embedding. Its geometric filtration orbit on H^1 is exactly the E-stable dual-polarization Lagrangians having dimension s at each embedding. Each pure determinant alternating form defining the Weil space transforms by c^s.
actual_source_dependencies: The source computes the geometric multiplier kernel as a product of SL_(2s), checks Shimura axioms and uses SL transitivity.
Its reference to the orbit calculation in thm:filtration is not dependence on that entire weak-admissibility existence result.

claims.remaining_obligation: Check connected reductivity, the nontrivial balanced adjoint Hodge components and the precise flag-orbit and determinant-multiplier statements. Geometric transitivity alone does not construct an admissible filtration.

claims.statement: Let R be a complete mixed-characteristic DVR finite over W(Fpbar) and Xcal,Ycal abelian schemes over R. A specified rational algebraic f0 in Hom^0(X0,Y0) whose contravariant crystalline map preserves the Hodge filtrations lifts uniquely to a rational homomorphism Xcal -> Ycal. A symmetric such X0 -> X0^dual lifts to a rational divisor class on the generic fiber, after finite extension for the divisor identification if necessary. Finite algebraic identities among lifted maps remain valid.
actual_source_dependencies: Filtered Dieudonne full faithfulness and Tate's extension theorem.
Specified-map Serre-Tate deformation, formal algebraization and rigidity/injective specialization.
Symmetric rational homomorphisms identify with rational divisor classes.
claims.known_result_reproduction: The source derives the assertion using cited classical lifting results; there is no independently developed Argus reproduction of this lemma.
claims.Argus_evidence_status: No assigned-ID evidence checks the algebraic lifting construction.

claims.statement: Let B/C be abelian and R in End^0(B) idempotent. Let E -> R End^0(B) R be a CM-field action with unit R, T=im(R) in rational first homology of E-rank 2s, and action zero on the complement. Suppose a rational divisor D has R^*D=D and split form sum_tau D_tau, with each D_tau in wedge^2 T_tau^dual tensor Q(1) nondegenerate. Then the rational subspace whose scalar extension is sum_tau wedge^(2s) T_tau^dual tensor Q(s), zero on the complement, consists of rational Lefschetz classes.
actual_source_dependencies: Rational pullbacks of the divisor by E-endomorphisms.
Coefficient extraction from (sum_tau x_tau^2 D_tau)^s and density of rational points of E.
Faithful scalar extension descends inclusion in the rational Lefschetz span; individual embedding lines need not be rational.
claims.known_result_reproduction: Complete elementary source argument, not an extra Argus proof or assessed novelty claim.
claims.Argus_evidence_status: No historical certificate supplies these geometric inputs or checks their polynomial-span application.
claims.remaining_obligation: Supply the actual rational projector/action and a divisor with the separate nondegenerate pure-block support, then justify coefficient generation and rational descent for this summand. The statement is not unconditional divisor-generation of every Weil class.

claims.statement: For good-reduction CM A/Qbar and r>0, every rational Hodge gamma in H^(2r)(A,Q(r)) is a finite sum of f_i^*eta_i, where f_i:A -> B_i are rational homomorphisms, B_i/Qbar have good reduction and eta_i are rational Weil classes. Each B_i has CM-field action K with K-rank 2r homology, signatures (r,r) at every embedding and a polarization inducing conjugation on K. The decomposition specializes with the same rational coefficients in all stated realizations; the source constructs B_i using rational idempotent factors of powers.

claims.attribution: OpenAI, The rational Hodge conjecture for CM abelian varieties, October 6, 2026, Theorem 1.1 as cited by the October 7 manuscript.
claims.statement: The assertion used here is that for a CM abelian variety B/C, every rational Hodge kappa in H^(2r)(B,Q(r)) is the Betti class of a rational algebraic cycle. The application takes B/Qbar, obtains a cycle over C and then spreads it to Qbar. This is the asserted input used in the reviewed manuscript, not a claim to have checked the full wording or hypotheses of the unseen companion theorem.

claims.attribution: OpenAI, with explicitly separate companion input.
claims.statement: For every prime p including 2 and fixed place w, if A/Qbar of dimension d has good reduction A0 and gamma is a rational Hodge class in H^(2r)(A,Q(r)), 0<=r<=d, then there is one z_gamma in CH^r(A0)_Q whose ell-adic cycle class equals gamma_(0,ell) for every ell!=p and whose crystalline cycle class equals gamma_(0,p) after extension to Cw. For every complementary y in CH^(d-r)(A0)_Q, all corresponding traces equal deg(z_gamma y). No uniqueness modulo rational equivalence, generic-fiber algebraicity or comparison across places is asserted.
actual_source_dependencies: CM transport supplies b=aj with gamma0=b^*kappa0.
The unverified companion supplies an algebraic representative on CM B_C; spreading and specialization give one Z0 on B0.
For h=Nb an actual homomorphism, z_gamma=N^(-2r)h^*Z0 via graph/refined Chow pullback.
Comparison, products and normalized traces identify every component, without separability or p not dividing N.
claims.known_result_reproduction: Conditional source consequence, not independently reproduced by Argus and not a novelty claim.
claims.Argus_evidence_status: No direct evidence certifies the combined algebraicity assertion or its external input.
claims.remaining_obligation: Verify the companion input and CM transport plus cycle spreading/specialization and rational Chow-pullback compatibility. The main rationality theorem alone or the local PF certificate does not yield this stronger cycle-representation claim.
